proposal: The published 2023 proof, for an arbitrary abelian variety C over the fixed number field K, explicitly chooses a K-isogenous MM variety D with h_F(D)<=h_F(C), and writes D as a K-product of simple abelian varieties. Set K=L-prime and C=J.

Since A is an L-prime-isogeny factor of J, it is an isogeny factor of D. Select a subproduct B of the simple factors of D, with multiplicities, L-prime-isogenous to A. Thus dim B=2 and D is isomorphic over L-prime to B times a complementary product E of dimension g-2. The selection uses the usual uniqueness of simple isogeny factors; its exact existing inventory/source must be checked.
Additivity of stable Faltings height on products and Bost give h_F(B)=h_F(D)-h_F(E)<=h_F(J)+3(g-2)/2<=H_J. Unlike the current proof, B need not embed into the original J.

Apply the unchanged Gaudron–Rémond Theorem1.9(1) to B and A over the same L-prime. The dimension2 degree bound and half-log height change give exactly the existing displayed surface-height bound. No change to constants or consumers is proposed.
